result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to card cropping at the screen edge and truncated text.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial image and truncated name/price.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is clearly indicated or adjust card width/spacing so cards are not abruptly cropped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated and unreadable due to the card being cut off.
issues.suggestion: Allow horizontal scrolling affordance (partial next card preview) but ensure text wraps or truncates with ellipsis properly rather than being sliced by the screen edge.

issues.description: The pizza promotion image at the bottom is cropped abruptly by the bottom navigation bar, cutting off part of the pizza and hiding restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add proper spacing or padding above the bottom navigation bar so content isn't cut off mid-image.

issues.description: The notification/profile icon in the top right shows a plain gray circle with a red dot but no avatar image or icon, making it look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add a proper profile avatar or icon placeholder image instead of a blank gray circle.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to cut off additional categories at the right edge without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial visible next item to indicate the row is scrollable.
